facts.fact: WHO's country office report for 2024-2025 describes DHIS2 as the Government's selected 'gold standard' platform for aggregate data, used to monitor HIV/PMTCT, RMNCAHA and immunisation across districts.

WHO's 2024-2025 report lists heavy reliance on paper-based reporting by facilities as a challenge and recommends revising the DHIS2 dashboards and trackers 'to enable onsite data capturing', so entry is not at the facility; the report does not name the level at which the paper reports are keyed (no figures given).

systems.owner: Government of Botswana / Ministry of Health (WHO technical support)
systems.tiers: aggregate data across districts; facilities report on paper; reporting described as incomplete or delayed
named only in a recommendation to revise them to enable onsite data capture (HIV mother-to-child transmission programme)
not stated; a monitoring system strengthened for the IPV2 vaccine rollout
